name: Improved Trample (Combat)
body:
You have honed your ability to crush your opponents under your mount’s hooves.

Prerequisite(s): Dex 13, Ride 6 ranks, Mounted Combat, Trample, base attack bonus +4.

Benefit: You do not provoke an attack of opportunity when performing an overrun combat maneuver while mounted. In addition, you receive a +2 bonus on checks made to overrun a foe while mounted.

Lost Lore: Horses of the Wild – Copyright 2014 Frog God Games; Author Rob Manning
